# WoodWorks

> WoodWorks provides free technical resources, design guidance, and project support for mass timber and wood construction across diverse building types and applications.

WoodWorks, operated by the Wood Products Council, is a comprehensive resource hub for architects, engineers, and builders seeking to implement wood-based construction methods. The site covers everything from light-frame and mass timber systems to hybrid construction, sustainability benefits, and evolving building codes that enable tall wood buildings.

## Key Topics

- Mass timber (CLT, GLT)
- Light-frame wood construction
- Hybrid wood construction
- Building code compliance
- Fire resistance and acoustics
- Embodied carbon and sustainability
- Multi-family and mixed-use buildings
- Panelized and off-site construction
- Tall wood buildings
- Commercial and residential design
- Educational and institutional projects
- Forest health and wildfire resilience
- Cost effectiveness
- Life cycle assessment

## Construction Systems & Methods

- [Mass Timber Construction - CLT & GLT](https://www.woodworks.org/learn/mass-timber-clt): Technical guide to cross-laminated timber and glue-laminated timber construction methods.
- [Light-Frame Wood Construction](https://www.woodworks.org/learn/light-frame): Design guide for light-frame wood buildings with building code compliance and case studies.
- [Hybrid Wood Building and Design](https://www.woodworks.org/learn/hybrid): Technical resources for hybrid wood construction combining steel, concrete, and wood elements.
- [Off-Site/Panelized Wood Construction](https://www.woodworks.org/learn/off-site-panelized-construction): Guide to panelized and prefabricated off-site wood construction methods and benefits.

## Building Type Applications

- [Multi-Family & Mixed-Use Wood Construction](https://www.woodworks.org/learn/multi-family-mixed-use): Resources for mass timber and light-frame systems in multi-family and mixed-use projects.
- [Commercial Low-Rise Construction](https://www.woodworks.org/learn/commercial-low-rise): Design guide for cost-competitive commercial low-rise wood construction.
- [Wood Office Buildings](https://www.woodworks.org/learn/office): Resources for designing mass timber and wood-frame office buildings.
- [Educational Buildings](https://www.woodworks.org/learn/education): Design guide for wood-frame and mass timber in educational building projects.
- [Institutional & Healthcare Projects](https://www.woodworks.org/learn/institutional-healthcare): Resources for wood construction in institutional and healthcare facility design.
- [Civic & Recreational Projects](https://www.woodworks.org/learn/civic-recreational): Design guidance for mass timber and wood-frame in civic and recreational projects.
- [Industrial Design & Manufacturing](https://www.woodworks.org/learn/industrial): Guide to mass timber applications in industrial and manufacturing facility design.

## Why Wood: Sustainability & Business Case

- [Wood for Sustainable and Biophilic Building Design](https://www.woodworks.org/why-wood/sustainability): Life cycle assessment tools and resources for evaluating wood's sustainability benefits.
- [Design, Engineer and Construct Code-Compliant Wood Buildings](https://www.woodworks.org/why-wood/evolving-codes): Overview of evolving building codes for tall and large mass timber structures.
- [Cost Effectiveness](https://www.woodworks.org/why-wood/business-case): Business case and cost-benefit analysis for wood construction projects.
- [Forests, Wildfire & Rural Communities](https://www.woodworks.org/why-wood/forests-wildfire-rural-communities): Information on wood's role in forest health, wildfire resilience, and rural economies.

## Tools & Technical Resources

- [Online Calculators](https://www.woodworks.org/tools-guides/online-calculators): Online tools for calculating building heights, areas, and carbon footprint estimates.
- [Mass Timber Fire & Acoustic Database](https://www.woodworks.org/mass-timber-fire-acoustic-database): Database of fire and acoustically rated mass timber assemblies and connections.

## Core Resources

- [WoodWorks Homepage](https://www.woodworks.org): WoodWorks homepage offering free project support and resources for mass timber and wood construction.
